name: io.github.glc-rag/geo-mcp
title: GLC Geo MCP
description: Free GeoNames-backed geospatial MCP: countries, cities, admin regions, marine, POIs (airports, peaks, lakes), coastal filters, distance and nearby search. Remote streamable HTTP; agents self-register for an API token.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer mcp_… API token. Agents: POST https://mcp.glc-rag.hu/api/auth/register with account_type=agent.
